facts.fact: 母女从坠落中苏醒——Rory是被Cora连声呼喊「MOM! Please be alright!」唤回意识的；两人已昏迷数小时、Rory手脚冻僵，且苏醒处离屏障只有几英尺，Rory立刻带Cora远离屏障。
facts.anchor: We must have been unconscious from the fall and lay in the cold for hours. My fingers and toes were stiff and chilled. I moved us further away from the barrier as we were only mere feet from it, far too close for my liking.

facts.fact: 天亮后Rory认出四周不是她们随Alec走过的那片森林，Cora也点头确认——她们已穿过屏障到了另一侧；Rory觉得这不可能是真的（原以为穿屏障必死），仍决定按原计划往Gorstine村方向走，想找到Alec或给Greta报信。
facts.anchor: I snapped my head toward Cora, eyes rounded. My breath caught, and she nodded slowly. This was not the same forest we traveled through with Alec.

facts.fact: 步行一小时的林中（一路只见鸟鸣、不见任何松鼠兔子鹿等动物），Cora多次坚称听到低语人声而Rory毫无所闻；Rory试着喊「Hello?」后森林骤然死寂、鸟鸣停止，她汗毛倒竖把Cora护在身后。
facts.anchor: “Shh! I heard a voice. A whisper.” She placed her dirt-covered index finger to her lips.

facts.fact: 树林里先传出低沉沙哑的喝斥「你们不受欢迎」，Rory道歉并求指路去Gorstine村；随后一名高大男性从大橡树后走出：宽肩、日晒色皮肤，皮裤上衣缀满蘑菇树叶苔藓，浅棕长发间编着柳枝、露出尖尖耳梢，手持短剑、背挎弓箭，猎绿色眼睛——Rory意识到眼前是一名seraph。
facts.anchor: An imposing figure took a deliberate step from behind a large oak tree. My jaw dropped. He was taller than most men I had encountered, with broad shoulders and sun-kissed skin.

facts.fact: 该seraph宣称母女带幼童闯入其领地、违反了条约，要把她们当作与王冠谈判的筹码，说话间臂上缠绕的藤蔓顺势垂到手上。
facts.anchor: “But now that you have brought a youngling into the forest and broken a treaty, you two will make for wonderful negotiation tools with the crown.” Vines that wound around his arms unfurled down to his hands.

facts.fact: Rory抱起Cora夺路而逃，只跑出五步就被树根绊倒双双摔倒；树根随即缠上Cora双腿把她钉在地上，荨麻缠住Rory脚踝蜇刺，她挣扎起身时摔在尖石上、手掌割开血流满前臂。
facts.anchor: I pivoted, grabbed Cora into my arms, and ran. Adrenaline coursed through my veins as Cora clutched me tightly and let out a small scream. Five steps were all I managed before my ankle caught underneath a tree root, throwing us both to the ground.

facts.fact: Rory挥拳想打他的头以争取逃脱，被他一把攥住手腕；他鸟一般歪头端详，血滴到他指上、目光落在她与他不同的圆耳上，惊问「你是什么？」；Rory哀求他放过Cora、把她自己带走，Cora哭喊不要母亲离开。
facts.anchor: He captured my wrist in his palm, cocking his head in a bird-like manner, staring inquisitively. Blood rolling down my hand dripped onto his fingers. His grip on me tightened, with piercing hunter-green eyes looking me up and down and landing on my rounded ears. He blinked. “You’re… You are not… What are you?”

facts.fact: 他正要开口，一支箭砰地射进他的心脏，他口中溢血、瞪着眼跪倒侧卧身亡；缠住母女双腿的植物随之松开，远处脚步声逼近，Rory扑到Cora身上把她的头按进胸口遮住惨状。
facts.anchor: The seraph opened his mouth to speak, but the sound of a thudding impact made him jolt. His wide eyes blinked before casting down at the arrow protruding from his heart. Blood dribbled out of his mouth, the ruby color a stark contrast to his sun-kissed skin.

facts.fact: 另一名高大seraph举着双手以示无敌意地走近：深蓝色眼睛、深棕皮装配绿罩衫、皮绳束发、腰插三把银匕首、背挎弓；他先问母女是否安然无恙，随后自我介绍「我是Gabriel，我是来帮忙的」。
facts.anchor: “Are you both alright?” asked a voice both calm and concerned, snapping my awareness back to my surroundings. Through blurred tears, I tracked another large seraph approaching us. His hands were held up in supplication, and worry etched his face.
